title: Triggering the Cravings and Hunger
approach: This ad was an attempt to make hyperbolic food visuals to create artifical hunger and cravings in the viewers head with a strong focus on fast visuals and strong hook

title: Keep the skin moisturized for the entire day
approach: This ad was designed in a conversational tone, as if a real influencer or content creator is speaking, the influencer tend to talk about how the moisturizer helped her, this was one of the very few ads, where we tried to bring up a generic ad.

title: Announce the offer
approach: This ad has an influencer talking about the business without revealing her face, while the main intention of the ad was to talk about the place and announce the audience about the current/recent offer provided by the cafe brand, this is another one of the few generic ads in our portfolio
